SEARCH
Package com.egradx.notification.config

Class EgradxNotificationAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.config.EgradxNotificationAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(before={org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.data.jpa.JpaRepositoriesAutoConfiguration.class,org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.orm.jpa.HibernateJpaAutoConfiguration.class}) @AutoConfigurationPackage(basePackageClasses=EgradxNotificationPackageMarker.class) @EnableConfigurationProperties(EgradxNotificationProperties.class) public class EgradxNotificationAutoConfiguration extends Object
Wires up egradx-notification. Picked up automatically by any application that depends on this jar.

Every bean here is @ConditionalOnMissingBean: an application replaces any piece — the transport, the dispatcher — by declaring its own, and adds a channel by declaring an EgradxNotificationChannel bean.

No component scanning, deliberately: a library that scans its own packages hands the host application beans it cannot opt out of.
